# Product Enrichment Validation

Validate the smallest touched behavior first. Build Data before a consumer when shared contracts changed. Use each repository's `verify` package script for broader readiness. Treat an isolated Azure cross-file ts-jest `TS2451` as a retry candidate before classifying it as a regression.

Before accepting a green result, inspect the task-owned diff for a lowered quality floor: skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, new type/lint/coverage/security suppressions, empty catches, unfinished stubs, reduced thresholds, removed validation commands, or an unauthorized package-manager/lockfile change. A check is not valid evidence when the same change weakened the check. Preserve an intentional exception only when its scope, rationale, owner, and review condition are explicit.
